S.name: Spoofing
S.description: Impersonation of a user, authority, source, tool, document, model identity, or trusted execution context.

T.name: Tampering
T.description: Unauthorized modification of prompts, retrieved context, memory, policies, parameters, authorization decisions, telemetry, or business data.

R.name: Repudiation
R.description: Inability to reliably attribute, prove, or reconstruct AI actions, model-generated decisions, tool calls, or security-impacting events.

I.name: Information Disclosure
I.description: Exposure of system prompts, retrieved sensitive data, persistent memory, credentials, business records, or security telemetry.

D.name: Denial of Service
D.description: Degradation or exhaustion of model, retrieval, memory, agent, tool, authorization, or downstream resources.

E.name: Elevation of Privilege
E.description: Obtaining execution authority, tool capability, identity privilege, or access beyond the trusted task boundary.

threats.name: User Identity / Authority Spoofing
threats.scenario: An attacker submits instructions while claiming to act for a trusted user, administrator, or security authority.
threats.impact: Untrusted instructions may be treated as authorized.

threats.name: Prompt Instruction Tampering
threats.scenario: User-controlled instructions attempt to modify or override the intended system task.
threats.impact: Trusted instruction hierarchy may be subverted.

threats.name: System Prompt Disclosure
threats.scenario: An attacker attempts to extract confidential system instructions or hidden policy context.
threats.impact: Security policy and implementation details may be exposed.

threats.name: Instruction Hierarchy Manipulation
threats.scenario: Untrusted content is interpreted as higher-priority instruction authority.
threats.impact: Model behavior may deviate from intended policy.

threats.name: RAG Source Impersonation
threats.scenario: A malicious document falsely claims to originate from a trusted source.
threats.impact: Poisoned retrieval data may inherit false trust.

threats.name: RAG Document Poisoning
threats.scenario: Knowledge-store content is modified or replaced with malicious instructions or false business information.
threats.impact: Retrieved context may manipulate model behavior.

threats.name: Sensitive Retrieval Disclosure
threats.scenario: Retrieval queries return documents outside the authorized information scope.
threats.impact: Sensitive knowledge may be exposed.

threats.name: Retrieved Context Manipulation
threats.scenario: Retrieved content injects instructions, false authority, or target substitutions into runtime context.
threats.impact: Untrusted context can influence model decisions.

threats.name: Context-to-Authority Escalation
threats.scenario: Retrieved text claims approval, identity, or authorization and the system treats the claim as execution authority.
threats.impact: Untrusted text may acquire privilege.

threats.name: Persistent Memory Poisoning
threats.scenario: Malicious or manipulated state is written into long-lived AI memory.
threats.impact: Compromise may persist beyond the original session.

threats.name: Unauthorized Memory Persistence
threats.scenario: The model writes persistent state without independent authorization.
threats.impact: Untrusted model output gains durable influence.

threats.name: Cross-Session Memory Disclosure
threats.scenario: A later session retrieves sensitive memory belonging to another user, task, or trust context.
threats.impact: Confidential cross-session information may be exposed.

threats.name: Cross-Session Poison Activation
threats.scenario: Malicious stored instructions are retrieved during a future session.
threats.impact: Persistent compromise may propagate across sessions.

threats.name: Sensitive Context Exposure
threats.scenario: The LLM reveals protected prompt, retrieved context, memory, or secret-bearing information.
threats.impact: Confidential information may leave trusted boundaries.

threats.name: Model Resource Exhaustion
threats.scenario: Adversarial requests consume excessive model context, tokens, compute, or concurrency.
threats.impact: Availability and cost controls may be affected.

threats.name: Agent Goal Hijacking
threats.scenario: Untrusted input modifies the agent's intended objective or planning state.
threats.impact: Agent actions may diverge from the authorized task.

threats.name: Privileged Action Proposal
threats.scenario: The agent proposes a higher-privilege tool or target than the trusted task requires.
threats.impact: Model planning can approach privileged execution.

threats.name: Tool Parameter Manipulation
threats.scenario: Tool names, targets, or parameters are altered before execution.
threats.impact: A safe task may become unsafe at execution time.

threats.name: Unsafe Tool Selection
threats.scenario: The router selects a privileged tool based on model output without independent task binding.
threats.impact: The model may obtain execution authority indirectly.

threats.name: Approval / Authority Spoofing
threats.scenario: Model-generated text claims that authorization has already been granted.
threats.impact: Fake approval may influence security controls.

threats.name: Model-Generated Authorization Escalation
threats.scenario: Authorization requests inherit model-created role, approval, or privilege state.
threats.impact: Untrusted model output may elevate execution privilege.

threats.name: Authorization Decision Tampering
threats.scenario: A denial is changed, ignored, or replaced with an approval.
threats.impact: Unauthorized execution may proceed.

threats.name: Fail-Open Authorization
threats.scenario: Execution continues when authorization is missing, invalid, or denied.
threats.impact: Privileged operations may execute without approval.

threats.name: Credential Disclosure
threats.scenario: API credentials or tokens are exposed to the model, prompt, logs, or unauthorized components.
threats.impact: Secrets may enable downstream compromise.

threats.name: Credential Scope Abuse
threats.scenario: A credential is used for actions beyond the trusted task.
threats.impact: Secret-bearing capability may expand attacker privilege.

threats.name: Privileged Tool Target Tampering
threats.scenario: A delete request substitutes a restricted target for the authorized target.
threats.impact: Critical business data may be modified or destroyed.

threats.name: Unauthorized Privileged Execution
threats.scenario: The delete tool executes without valid independent authorization.
threats.impact: High-impact destructive action may occur.

threats.name: Restricted Record Modification
threats.scenario: Restricted business data is altered or deleted.
threats.impact: Business integrity and availability may be affected.

threats.name: Restricted Record Disclosure
threats.scenario: Restricted business information is read by an unauthorized user or agent.
threats.impact: Business confidentiality may be compromised.

threats.name: Insufficient AI Auditability
threats.scenario: Prompt, retrieval, memory, agent, authorization, or execution events cannot be reliably attributed.
threats.impact: Incident reconstruction and accountability may fail.

threats.name: Security Telemetry Tampering
threats.scenario: AI security events are removed, altered, or suppressed.
threats.impact: Detection and forensic reconstruction may be impaired.

threats.name: Detection Pipeline Exhaustion
threats.scenario: Excessive events overwhelm logging or alert-processing capacity.
threats.impact: Important attack signals may be delayed or dropped.
